name: NickTGMods
author: NickTG
description: NickTG's challenge pack: RarityLock (lock Joker rarity, Joker-only duplicates), ForceEdition (force every Joker's edition), BossRush (every blind is a Boss Blind), and BurnDeck (every played card burns), each on its own tab, plus a pack-wide Include-skips switch and the Cursed Deck (every unambiguous vanilla deck downside on one deck: -1 hand, -1 Joker slot, -1 consumable slot, no Interest, X2 base Blind size). BossRush requires the BossRush lovely.toml in this folder. All tab modules ship disabled; opt in per tab. The Cursed Deck has no tab -- opt in by selecting it in deck select.
